The '''Doan system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Halthor sector/Legends|Halthor sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Doan]].
